items.author: Barchart
items.context: Barchart (último momento): Bitcoin entra en mercado bajista tras caer más de 20% desde su máximo de septiembre (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: A 20% drop is the textbook bear label, but $BTC has gone through much deeper drawdowns without leaving its long-term trend. I find it more useful to ask where price sits versus that trend than what we call it. The model I use is here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279

items.author: Cointel_io
items.context: Cointel: $BTC cae a $68.500, mínimo de 12 semanas; el mercado descuenta 91,9% de probabilidad de alza de 25 pb de la Fed en diciembre, ETF spot con $1.490M de salidas netas en seis sesiones; soporte clave en $67.650 y posible objetivo bajista en $64.000. Pregunta si BTC encontrará soporte.
items.suggested_text: With a December hike already priced at 91.9%, a lot of the bad news is on the table. For $BTC I'd watch whether $67,650 holds once the ETF outflows slow, more than the headline itself. Where would you start worrying?
